camera.reason: 50MP OIS main with a usable 12MP ultrawide and 4K video, no telephoto.

performance.reason: Exynos 1580 handles most games at medium to high settings.

battery.reason: 5,000mAh lasts a full day plus with 45W charging.

display.reason: 6.7 inch FHD+ Super AMOLED at 120Hz with HDR10+ and 1,200 nits HBM.

build.reason: Aluminium frame and Gorilla Glass Victus+ front and back with IP67.

software.reason: Samsung promises 6 Android upgrades and 6 years of security patches.

value.reason: At 148,000 it costs the same as its newer successor, the Galaxy A57, which has a faster chip and IP68.
